periods.label: 以道旁之岩灰留下求救线索

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: rescued with Rinna and the others after the Tatra base escape

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Adoptive sister-like mistress; Sara accepts Rinna's order to endure torture together.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Hides Charlotte with Roadside Ash, enabling her to call Ouma.
relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Adoptive guardian who is pressured through Sara's suffering.
relationships.carl-arlanz: Former benefactor who once treated her illness but now uses her as torture leverage.

periods.summary: Sara accompanies Kazamatsuri's party to the Tyrant's throne room and sees the frozen corpse for the first time. When PSYON captures the group, she uses Roadside Ash to make Charlotte fade from notice, creating the chance for a rescue message. In the Tatra base, Arlanz has Sara and Rinna stripped, bound and burned with fantasy-form pyrokinesis to force Kazamatsuri and Tsukikage to cooperate. Sara resolves to repay the Kazamatsuri family but collapses under the torture. Ouma later finds her unconscious during the rescue.

key_events.summary: Witnesses the Tyrant's corpse and hides Charlotte before PSYON removes the captives.
Is tortured alongside Rinna as leverage against the adults.
Is discovered unconscious when Ouma's battle breaks into the holding area.
